Sixteen inclusive upper column bounds at $074E (bytes: 01 03 FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF), read by $4115. Resident $411C takes the first of entries 0 to 14 whose bound is at least the coarse column, and entry 15 when none is; the last byte ($075D) is never read. So region 0 is columns up to 1, region 1 is 2-3 and region 2 is everything above.

Sixteen zero bytes ($075E-$076D) between the column thresholds and the selectors. The scan at $411C reads at most index 14 ($075C), so it reads none of them. The resident uses $075E,X/Y as per-cell state for special map cells: $381C increments the counter of the cell just entered, and $38FE (update_grid_special_cell) reads and writes it at $3901 and $3915, with Y the low nibble of a special map cell.
